title: SyntexLabs | ItemCrates
description: A plugin that transforms items into reward crates.
body:

# ItemCrates

ItemCrates is a powerful and modern crate plugin designed for Minecraft servers that want a clean, lightweight, and highly customizable reward system.
The plugin is built with performance in mind, allowing even low-end servers to run advanced crate systems smoothly without impacting gameplay performance.

Whether you run a survival server, minigame network, or competitive PvP server, ItemCrates gives you full control over rewards, commands, crate management, and customization.

Make sure to join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/NN6Eg2JrES) server if any bugs or issues occur.

The plugin is fully customizable and allows you to configure crate names, reward chances, command rewards, messages, prefixes, and more.

The Plugin comes with the following commands:

## Commands

* `/crate create <id> <name>`
* `/crate delete <id>`
* `/crate list`
* `/crate rename <id> <name>`
* `/crate give <id> [player]`
* `/crate info <id>`
* `/crate addreward <id> <chance%> <name>`
* `/crate removereward <id> <rewardid>`
* `/crate listrewards <id>`
* `/crate addcommand <id> <rewardid>`
* `/crate listcommands <id> <rewardid>`
* `/crate removecommand <id> <rewardid> <#index>`
* `/crate reload`

**Permission for this plugin:**
- _syntex.crateadmin_

---

# Features

## 📦 Advanced Crate System

Create unlimited custom crates with unique names, rewards, and command executions. Perfect for vote crates, legendary crates, seasonal rewards, and more.

## 🎁 Reward Management

Add rewards with fully customizable drop chances. Rewards can contain items, commands, or multiple actions executed at once.

## ⚡ Command Rewards

Attach unlimited console commands to rewards. Easily integrate economy plugins, ranks, custom items, permissions, and more.

## 🛠️ Fully In-Game Configurable

Manage your entire crate setup directly in-game without editing configuration files manually.

## 🎨 Modern Design

Built with a clean and modern structure that fits perfectly into professional Minecraft server environments.

## 🔄 Live Reloading

Reload all crate configurations instantly using `/crate reload` without restarting your server.

## 📋 Reward Information

Inspect every crate and reward directly in-game using intuitive information and listing commands.

## 🚀 High Performance

SyntexItemCrates is optimized for low resource usage and fast reward handling, ensuring smooth performance even on heavily populated servers.

## 🔒 Safe & Reliable

The plugin safely handles reward distribution and command execution while preventing duplicate rewards or execution issues.

---

# Performance

SyntexItemCrates is designed around performance and scalability.
All crate data is cached efficiently, reward lookups are optimized, and unnecessary processing is avoided entirely during normal server operation.

The plugin is lightweight, responsive, and suitable for any type of Minecraft server.

---

# Requirements

Minecraft: **1.21+**
Java: **21+**
Server Software: **Paper / Spigot**
